name: Maxim
source: Mr. Maxim is [url=https://vndb.org/c29768]Sharumi[/url]'s father and an influental businessman that has ties with the government. The rape and murder of an innocent woman in his village got him disturbed and so he wants the military to intervene and find the culprit. And so the government had sent him one of their finest lieutenants, Lieutenant [url=https://vndb.org/c29770]Prosper[/url]. The rather old and naive Mr. Maxim doesn't even know yet what kind of a devil he just invited to his humble abode but will surely find out soon enough.
